response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong TDD and craftsmanship background, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Long, diverse software engineering career (15+ years) with staff/senior titles
Some low-level systems experience (DLang async I/O, fibers, high-performance databases)
Demonstrated leadership via talks, workshops, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No evidence of SoC, IP modeling, or chip architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
Career focus is web/mobile/backend product engineering, not hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No AI accelerator / deep-learning / GPU performance expertise
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
